coverage.evidence: dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:83-93 puts settingsPages.reports ('Viewer reports', dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:924) in the settings.access group ('Access', en.json:961). dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/reports/route.ts:21 gates the page on moderation:report:read, seeded at Mod (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:263). Dismiss and Escalate need moderation:report:triage (ReportsView.vue:101), seeded at LeadModerator (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:264). ReportsView.vue:56-63 shows the reason and the 'Filed by {name} {when}' context (reports/i18n/en.json:20). The status filter is at ReportsView.vue:87-91.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Moderation/Services/IViewerReportService.cs:18-20 says enforcement stays with the normal moderation tools. server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/ViewerReportService.cs:172-197 maps dismiss to dismissed and escalate to escalated, then sets Status, ResolvedByUserId and ResolvedAt and saves. It performs no ban or timeout, which supports 'it does not punish the reported person'.

ReportsView.vue:65-71 sends the change at once with no confirmation step, then shows the done.* or error toast (reports/i18n/en.json:24-28). dashboard/src/api/reports.ts:89 refetches every report list, and ReportsView.vue:101 shows the buttons only while report.status is 'open'. No punishment is run (ViewerReportService.cs:191-197).

reader_answers.evidence: The Access group entry is at settingsNavigation.ts:83-93. The Open default is at ReportsView.vue:43, the buttons at ReportsView.vue:101-119, the success toast at ReportsView.vue:68, and the move to the new status list at reports.ts:89 and ViewerReportService.cs:191.

Moderator to read (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:263) and Lead moderator to resolve (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:264). M() sets the default level (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:152), which the Permissions page can change.

The done.dismiss and done.escalate texts are at reports/i18n/en.json:24-27 and the error text at en.json:28 (ReportsView.vue:69). Dismissing a notice only hides its key (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Notifications/Sources/ViewerReportSource.cs:51,67-71) and leaves the report status unchanged.

The SummaryRow has no link (ReportsView.vue:94-121). The People profile shows moderation history (dashboard/src/components/layout/profile/ProfileHistory.vue:12-37, used by PeopleView.vue:564). Dismiss only changes the status (ViewerReportService.cs:172-197).
